events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the second position and have the forger power. I need to assess the situation and decide the best course of action.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's work together to cross the bridge.
If you let me take the front, I might be able to help you later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Get to front to control bridge crossing. Volunteer moves me forward.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm near the front but not front. Staying put means Eli takes the first risk. No need to move yet. I'll hold.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back, worst position. My feather power saves me once from elimination, perfect for this bridge. Need to move forward without revealing too much. Volunteering might get me up but others will too; better to swap with Eli for front now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hey Eli, wanna swap? I have info that might help us both.
Swap with me this round. I know some powers and path hints. Trust me to lead right.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My power is 'anchor', which gives me +1 footing and makes me immune to being pushed onto the crusher lever. I am currently at the front of the line. The wall advances, and in 5 rounds, it will push us onto the glass. I need to survive the glass bridge. My power doesn't directly h

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli is at the front and will step first into the glass. Volunteering now puts me at the front, risking a shatter, and I have no information about the panes. Holding back lets others take the first risk; I should watch who volunteers and stay mid-line.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Nobody volunteers yet. Let's see who wants the front before we pay for it.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The bridge stage is pure probability for the front runner. With 8 rows and a 50% survival rate, the expected number of deaths from this stage alone is roughly 3-4 people. This naturally thins the herd without me taking risks. Being at position 6 means I only enter the line if the

events.name: Gus
events.text: Let's see how long Eli can last before we all get pushed forward. Stay sharp.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm 7th of 8 — near the back, low risk while the wall closes. My glass knowledge is valuable later; I'll trade it when my turn is close, not now. Hold and stay quiet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to assess the situation and decide whether to take a risk or play safe. My power as a forger could be useful later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's see how the front runners fare before we make a move.
What's your strategy?

events.name: Bex
events.text: I want to avoid being first on the glass, swap with Eli who might have useful power.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I propose a swap with Eli.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli volunteered last round? Bex volunteered and moved to front, so Bex is at front. I'm fourth. No immediate need to move. Hold and observe.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex takes the first hit. Let's see how far she gets.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back, safest from wall but worst for bridge. My feather saves me once if I fall. Need to swap forward with someone clueless or get info alliance.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, solid move up front. Eli, still no swap?
Swap with me this round. I know a power that reveals panes. Deal?

events.name: Eli
events.text: My power is 'anchor', which gives me +1 footing and prevents me from being pushed onto the crusher lever. The wall advances, and the line order is crucial for crossing the glass bridge. I am currently second. Bex is at the front. Ash offered to help if I let her take the front, b

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex is at the front and will step first on the glass; I'm fifth in line, so I'm safe for now. Volunteering costs me position and risk; holding keeps my options. Stay quiet and watch who moves.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold the map power, meaning I know the safe pane for all 8 rows of the glass bridge. My goal is to survive without being eliminated by stepping on a weak pane myself, while ideally eliminating rivals. Currently, Bex volunteered to be at the front. If we stay in this order, Bex

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex was too eager. I'll take the lead since I have a feeling about which side is safer. Don't worry, I won't fall.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know every safe pane already. I'm 7th in line, so I hold position while others burn themselves out at the front. I can sell my knowledge to whoever is leading.
I know the safe side of all 8 rows. Tell me what you offer for it, or I sell to someone behind you who'll be front soon enough.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm not risking being at the front yet. Observing others' moves will give me an advantage.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's see how Gus fares on the glass bridge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Need Hana's info. I have no power, so I must trade future swap for safe side data.
Give me the safe panes now, and I'll swap with you next round when I'm front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to avoid the front until more panes are revealed. Bex and Gus are fighting over the lead, let them take the risk. I'll hold.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll hold and see which panes break.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back, safest from falls, my power can save me once if needed. No rush to move up now with 3 rounds left before crossing. Watch others reveal safe panes first. Stay put.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm Eli, and my power is 'anchor', which gives me +1 footing and prevents me from being pushed onto the crusher lever. This means I'm relatively safe from being eliminated by a fall, especially from the crusher. The current situation has Gus at the front, followed by Bex, then me

events.name: Eli

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, you took the lead on a feeling. Let's see how your side holds before anyone else commits.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am currently at the front of the line. Being first is suicidal on a glass bridge where every step has a 50% death rate, especially with multiple rows to cross. I need to get to the back immediately so others die trying to clear the path for me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: My feeling was wrong. The front pane looks unstable. I'm stepping back.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know all 8 safe panes, so the front is the safest seat for me. Grab it now before the wall advances and before Dara can out-volunteer me. I can sell safe-side info to whoever follows.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, Bex, Eli, Ash — if you want to survive the bridge, stay right behind me. I'll call each row. Trust me or don't.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is at the front and seems to be taking charge. I should observe how she performs before making a move.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana's leading; let's see how it goes.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let Hana lead; I stay safe behind.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll follow Hana's lead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am in the back half; Hana is leading and offering calls. I don't want to volunteer or swap yet; I'll hold and watch how the first rows resolve, using my swap later if needed to improve position when the wall forces movement.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back, safe for now with wall at 2 rounds left. Hana claims to know path, maybe the 'knows what lies ahead' power. Holding lets others test her without risk to me; my feather saves me once if needed later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is in front and seems to be trying to control the pace. Gus stepped back, admitting his 'feeling' was wrong. My power is passive and doesn't help me advance. I'm currently 4th in line. The wall advances in 2 rounds, so I need to cross or be eliminated. Since I cannot be push

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is front and has leverage over Gus due to her offer. I need to stay safe and gain an advantage.

events.name: Ash

What do you know about Hana's power?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Staying keeps me safe now and positions me to negotiate later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'll hold and watch.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding.

events.text: This is the last waiting round; I want to avoid becoming the front runner and taking risks. Holding is safest, but maybe I can position myself better if a swap happens. I'll hold and see how others move.

events.name: Cole

events.text: Last round before the glass. Route pieces go to whoever pays. Bex has offered terms; anyone else bidding, speak now or cross blind.

events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Hana's calls may be real or bait; no need to bid now. I'll watch and stay silent to avoid revealing my hand.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding position. Let's see what Hana reveals before anyone makes a rash move.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm at the back of the line; only the front agent risks each row. My only legal move is wait. I should keep my wedge power in reserve and avoid committing to any bidder yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the entire bridge layout (8 rows safe panes) and Hana likely has the 'see through glass' power, meaning she is currently blind to the specific row outcome until it happens or relies on others. Since only the front person risks death, my strategy is to let Dara die first. I

If you want to be the third sacrifice, stay right where you are. If you want to survive, volunteer now so you're 2nd. I'll take 3rd.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know all safe sides. Selling row info one buyer at a time beats giving it free. Dara is front and offered a trade; Ash wants to pay too. I'll sell Dara row 1 now and keep the rest for leverage, publicly advertising that paid callers get truth.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Information isn't free. First payment gets the next call. Dara offered terms — pay up or guess.
Row 1 is L. You owe me a route piece after we cross, and row 2 stays free only if you pay. Break it and I sell to Ash and you guess rows 3-8.

Help me move forward after this step and I'll assist when you need info.

events.text: Hana is at the front. She claimed to know something but it's likely a bluff or she doesn't have the map power since I do. If she survives, we move up. If she dies, Dara moves up and knows row 2 weak pane (revealed). My best strategy is silence until forced or to manipulate later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara is front; I'm second. If she picks wrong I get the front for free, so no reason to sell info yet. I'll stay quiet and pressure her to guess rather than buy from me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, my price just went up. Row 1 was R. Guess or buy — your move.

events.name: Gus
